materials.name: Synthetic prisoner game notes
materials.text: Two players simultaneously choose Cooperate or Defect. Payoffs are ordered row player first, column player second. If both Cooperate, payoffs are 3,3. Row Cooperate and column Defect gives 0,5. Row Defect and column Cooperate gives 5,0. Both Defect gives 1,1. A best response maximizes one player's own payoff holding the other player's choice fixed. Against column Cooperate, the row player gets 3 by Cooperating and 5 by Defecting, so Defect is better. Against column Defect, the row player gets 0 by Cooperating and 1 by Defecting, so Defect is better. Thus Defect strictly dominates Cooperate for the row player. By symmetry Defect also strictly dominates for the column player, and Defect,Defect is the unique Nash equilibrium.

decision.rpcCaveat: Asynchronous next-thread preparation can finish after a following sample starts. Such thread/start log atMs values refer to its original send sample; only thread/start before that sample turn/start is foreground setup. This does not change text/PCM/model completion timestamps.
